description: Add a teammate, or a table, bay or room, to an event type so visitors can book them. Pass the opening hours (scheduleId) they work for it. A teammate is named by their email and must already be on the project; adding someone who is already on the event type returns them unchanged. For multi-step Replo work, call skills with name "replo".

eventTypeId.description: The event type's id, from replo_event_types_list

projectId.description: The project that owns the forms, from list_projects

scheduleId.description: The opening hours this staff member works for this event type

staff.description: A teammate, or a table, bay or room that isn't a person

email.description: A teammate's email; they must already be on the project

name.description: The name visitors see; their account name if left out, or the name they already have on another event type
A table, bay or room, such as Table 4

weight.description: Share of bookings when the visitor doesn't pick: a host with weight 2 gets about twice as many as one with weight 1

name: replo_booking_staff_add
title: Add staff to an event type
